rv.q: There is a provocatively uneasy balance between gallows humour and real-world violence – and it is one that Chris Sonnex’s production has yet to get quite right.
This is a quirky and pin-sharp treatment of a visceral piece of theatre.

cn.t: Mixed-to-positive reviews for McDonagh's bloody black comedy. Critics praise its sharp satire on political violence, though opinions vary on its impact—one finds it darkly hilarious, another more measured in its comic payoff.
